variants.stem: Use the unit circle. When the terminal ray of θ meets the circle at P, sin θ is the y-coordinate of P and cos θ is its x-coordinate.

parts.prompt: Find sin(−3π).
Find cos(−5π/2).
How many angles θ with 0 ≤ θ ≤ 2π satisfy cos θ = 1?
